purpose: Final hero-detail integrity gate and page-ready output contract.

presentationRules: Base mode is shown first; SP mode is shown only when SP data exists.
Exclusive equipment and covenant sections remain present and may display 미출시 instead of being omitted.
Skin ordering is release order and must preserve acquisition metadata when available.
Skills are ordered by acquisition group when the source relation is available: tier1, tier2, SP, awakening.
Do not emit subjective ratings or recommended gear.

PASS: heroId is unique and exists in the canonical hero master
required upstream normalized record exists once stages 4-5 populate it
normal Job/Skill references contain no unresolved hard relation errors
when SP exists, SP record resolves to the same canonical heroId and referenced SP missions exist
REVIEW: display/enrichment fields such as CV, factions, origin, artwork, skins, bonds, exclusive equipment, covenant, soldiers or stat labels are not connected yet
skill/job Korean display names are pending while IDs and source relations are valid
Hero-SP MissionType 73 material-bundle detail remains unverified
FAIL: Job/Skill/Mission reference points to a missing record
SP record belongs to an unknown hero
one hero receives multiple incompatible SP ownership records

completionRule: Stage 3-4 is complete when the final output contract, PASS/REVIEW/FAIL policy, upstream stage boundaries and safe failure rules are fixed. Actual 267-hero page-data generation belongs to stage 6 after stages 4-5 populate battle and detail data.
notes: The former SOURCE_BLOCKED state was cleared after required Job/Skill/SP/Mission ConfigData exports were repaired.
heroId is the only canonical join key; Korean names are display values.
The corrected heroId 99164 name is canonical-source-confirmed through data/hero-name-corrections.v1.json.
Stage 3 defines the pipeline and QA contract; it does not pre-empt stages 4-6 data population.
